contributor: ChatGPT independent causal retention research contributor
scientific_status: UNPREREGISTERED_POSTHOC. Both original archived development sources, reset events, and old-world scores were already inspected before proposing this gate. No scientific first use or confirmatory gain is claimed.
question: Can a single frozen native old-context readout and the unchanged adaptively resetting native readout be combined by fixed-share Bayesian evidence from previously witnessed public outcomes, without sacrificing new-law adaptation? Does the gate beat an unadapted half-mixture and both single-readout baselines on these already consumed cases?
hypothesis: A small deterministic history-driven gate can change weights after observed causal outcomes, reducing the retention-adaptation conflict of naive reset suppression. Its test may fail; no hyperparameters adjusted after running.
prerequisite_evidence: Reset-only archival effect PASS two OS, run 44629351965, posthoc +0.044890314/+0.080409588 old Brier after reset
Reset-suppression tradeoff PASS two OS, run 44631935621, posthoc old-Brier lower but later prequential higher

P0 historic member retrieval vs fully pooled history retrospective no clear gain, PR #1329 comment #7024237726. This contribution tests a DIFFERENT matched JEPA2 native original-vs-current policy pair and cannot be treated as independent scientific source.

frozen_design.source_scope: exact 16 previous development episodes after 1006 or 981 original native observations; zero fresh source actions, no new tests invoking source.py or original campaign.py
frozen_design.probe_scope: same previously consumed last 32 old-world native episodes used by frozen JEPA2-05 old-score diagnostic
frozen_design.actions: exact original observed intervention decisions, matched across all controls; no new action selection
frozen_design.capacity: ONE active native learner as the only learner, ONE immutable read-only pre-continuation native snapshot (not a trainer), fixed scalar Bayesian weight. No new hidden models or extra source actions.
frozen_design.prequential_forecasts: For each of the 16 continuation episodes, compute predictions from unchanged active native and frozen anchor BEFORE observe. For each policy, score 0.5*(transition Brier+conditional terminal Brier). After each complete witnessed event, use action consequence likelihood to update gate weight; no label or phase inputs.
frozen_design.weight_mechanism: fixed-share prior w_old=0.5, share_alpha=1/8 after normalized likelihood Bayes update; likelihood of episode = P(s2 observed|view,x1)*P(y observed|view,x1,s2,x2), full observation. Gate terminal forecast conditions old-vs-active expert weights on observed s2, so two-stage predictions remain probabilistically coherent.
controls: exact unchanging 50:50 mixture with correct conditional-terminal mixture
fixed-share Bayesian evidence gate alpha=1/8; prequential previous public outcomes only
source-exact sham native replay for original checkpoint equality
no-reset previous qualified run 44631935621, contextual comparison only, not mixed into scoring
frozen_design.phase_roster: A_initial new indices 0-5, B_change 6-10, A_return 11-15 for evaluation only, never readout or gate input; all 16 witness forecasts prequential
negative_controls: Fixed 50:50 prior mixture prevents attributing gains merely to access to old readout
Cold immutable anchor SHA and unmodified final native checkpoint SHA verified
Run same exact 16 outcomes on both independent OS, check prequential/old-probe numerical parity
frozen_design.no_post_selection: No retuning share_alpha, prior, variants, scoring, phase boundaries or retention thresholds after first outcome.
frozen_design.budget: At most 2 archived seeds x 16 observed steps, no source actions, <=15 min source-evaluation per OS plus <=40 min mandatory full original cross-platform regression

metrics: Prequential whole-16 and phase-specific Brier for adaptive, frozen anchor, constant half mixture, fixed-share gate
Last-32 old-probe Brier for same four readouts with final gate posterior
Gate old expert weight before/after each already observed event and after all 16, posterior range and cold-source pins
Relative prequential Brier compared with both single readouts and fixed half mixture
Per-seed archived source replay PASS, no changed native or source data, two-platform exact numeric parity

classification_rules.posthoc_promising: ARCHIVED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY if on BOTH seeds gate prequential whole-16 Brier does not exceed adaptive+0.005 AND gate final historical old Brier <= original(old)+0.03, plus exact source controls and two-OS parity. This is NOT a scientific pass or integration permission.
classification_rules.posthoc_negative: ARCHIVED_NEGATIVE if either seed fails both retrospective criteria, or gate is weakly worse than constant-half on both full-16 prequential scores. Preserve full result and don't retune.
classification_rules.posthoc_mixed: ARCHIVED_MIXED if some metrics improve but either seed breaches the combined strict posthoc promising criteria.
classification_rules.invalid: REPRODUCTION_FAIL on any original/final archived cold source SHA mismatch, old-probe published Brier error>1e-10, nonfinite weights/prediction, source/phase leakage, active-model state mismatch, changed source file, new source action, wrong original 16 witness suffix or missing exact atlas.
classification_rules.science_pass: False for all outcomes: this data and gate design are posthoc and do not qualify unseen transfer, statistically independent improvement or official model promotion.
